sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
The gray tab click had no effect either. So far, 4 clicks have all failed: green body, green dot, red X, green tab.
Let me think more carefully. Maybe the interaction isn't a single click on the object. Could it be a drag? But the only valid action is MOUSE (click). Hmm, but maybe the game uses click-and-hold, or the MOUSE action is a click at a position, and the game is something like "click a cell to toggle it" (like a cellular automaton / Lights Out).
Or maybe I'm wrong about what's clickable. Let me reconsider the scene:
- Two containers with glyphs. The top container has green E/Ǝ glyphs, the bottom has yellow U/∩ glyphs.
- A green block (3x5) and a yellow bar (8x3).
- Red X markers.
Maybe the glyphs are "arrows" indicating where the blocks should go? E/Ǝ face each other horizontally; U/∩ face each other vertically.
Or, this could be a "connect the pairs" game: the green block corresponds to the green glyph, the yellow bar to the yellow glyph. The red X might be a "power source."
Hmm, let me think about the red dot inside the block. In the green block, the dot is at [10,31] — the 2nd column from the right, middle row. In the yellow bar, the dot is at [34,10] — the 2nd row from the bottom, middle column. These look like "eyes" — the blocks are little creatures facing right (green) and down (yellow). The red X could be a "target" the creature is supposed to reach.
Maybe the game is: click on the creature to make it take one step toward the target? But clicking the body did nothing...
Wait — maybe the click needs to land exactly on a specific pixel, and my click was registered as a "miss" (the timer decreases on any click, but only clicks on the correct target do something). I clicked the center of the green block [10,30] — that's an N pixel. The dot [10,31] — an r pixel. The X center [10,52] — a B pixel. The tab [10,27] — a G pixel.
Maybe the target is the glyph inside the container. Let me try clicking the green E glyph at [21,39] (center of the left glyph) and the Ǝ glyph at [21,45].
Or, the target might be the center of the charcoal cell.
Or — a completely different idea: maybe the game is a "memory / Simon" type: click the X marker in the correct order? Or the red X is a "bomb" and you must not click it.
Let me try the glyph. I'll click the left green glyph at [21,39].
